terms.gloss: the slave in charge of the ātrium and so of the house: the steward
evidence: Plaut. Ps. 609: Quasi tē dīcās ātriēnsem.

phrases.latin: Condus prōmus sum, prōcūrātor penī. — Quasi tē dīcās ātriēnsem. — Immō ātriēnsī ego imperō.
phrases.english: I am the keeper and giver-out of the stores, the manager of the larder. — As if to say you were the steward. — No, I give the steward his orders.
